title:
The async effect to open a confirmation modal
 for deleting an entity. This effect addresses a common scenario where a
 grid row action triggers downstream effect(s) of deleting an entity.
 It updates the modal instance with the context variables extracted from the grid row,
 the entity type from configured action args and the redux action to emit when confirm
 button is clicked.
 The payload passed to this will include obj: {gridField1: gridField1Value, ...gridFieldN: gridFieldNValue}

```
 "args": {
    "entityType": "string", // the type of the entity to be deleted
    "confirmActionType": "string", // the Redux action to emit when confirmed
    // The path from obj to the field containing data to be used when the modal displays.  Default 'name'
    "pathToDisplayName": "string",
 }
```
name: UiSdlEpicShowConfirmDeleteEntityModalFromGridRowAction
